verdict.rationale: Devin exposes a documented API (session creation, create_as_user_id) and an MCP server giving full access to session management, playbooks, knowledge, and scheduling, suggesting broad but not confirmed full parity with the UI. There's no evidence of an OpenAPI spec (probe found only 404s) or explicit documentation stating that UI-only features like Computer Use, Desktop app configuration, or Devin Review/Auto-Fix workflows can be triggered via the API. missing for 10: explicit API/MCP coverage of Computer Use, Devin Review, Auto-Fix and Desktop-specific settings, and a published OpenAPI spec confirming full endpoint parity.
